findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?
findings.quote: minim 30 de aplicații și sisteme IT&C, prin intermediul cărora sunt furnizate servicii digitale guvernamentale, vor fi migrate în cloud până în iunie 2026.
findings.quote_english: at least 30 IT&C applications and systems through which government digital services are provided will be migrated to the cloud by June 2026.
findings.value: Partly: the government cloud is still being populated, with at least 30 applications to be migrated by June 2026
findings.title: Investiția 2 – Migrarea aplicațiilor și sistemelor informatice în cloud (MAS IC)
findings.note: The ADR project page for the migration investment (project term 06.07.2023 to 30.06.2026) shows the government cloud was still being built and populated, which supports 'Partly'.

findings.question: indicator K1: Is the root of the government's public key infrastructure or its qualified trust service operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: OU=Autoritatea de Certificare STS ROOT G2, O=STS, C=RO Fh4HOeG7MT/ugThqcLbBhVKVF98= http://uri.etsi.org/TrstSvc/TrustedList/Svcstatus/granted 2020-11-13T22:00:00Z
findings.quote_english: OU=Certification Authority STS ROOT G2, O=STS, C=RO [key id] status granted 2020-11-13
findings.value: Yes: the Special Telecommunications Service (STS), a state body, runs the qualified root CA 'STS ROOT G2' with granted status on Romania's trusted list
findings.title: Romanian Trusted List (TSL)
findings.note: This is the official eIDAS trusted list XML, referenced from the EU LOTL and issued 2026-09-28. It independently shows a state body (STS) as a qualified trust service provider; the source is XML, so the quote joins text from adjacent elements.

review.reason: The trusted list shows the STS ROOT G2 service with status 'granted'. Its TSP entry names the operator as Serviciul de Telecomunicatii Speciale (Special Telecommunications Service), a state body, so the root is state-operated.

findings.quote: CN=SRI Root CA, OU=UM 0296, OID.2.5.4.97=VATRO-14381010, O=SRI, C=RO pme+pWxykYvdBBhAd2S8HWSi9FY= http://uri.etsi.org/TrstSvc/TrustedList/Svcstatus/granted 2026-07-10T07:00:00Z

findings.question: indicator L2: Is the government's data classification scheme established in a statute or binding regulation?
findings.quote: ORNISS exercită atribuţii de reglementare, autorizare, evidenţă şi control în conformitate cu prevederile Legii nr. 182/2002 privind protecţia informaţiilor clasificate, ale Standardelor naţionale de protecţie a informaţiilor clasificate în România, aprobate prin Hotărârea Guvernului nr. 585/2002
findings.quote_english: ORNISS exercises regulatory, authorisation, record-keeping and control powers under Law no. 182/2002 on the protection of classified information and the National standards for the protection of classified information in Romania, approved by Government Decision no. 585/2002
findings.value: Yes: classified information is governed by Legea nr. 182/2002 and the national standards approved by Hotărârea Guvernului nr. 585/2002
findings.title: ORNISS – Atribuţii
findings.publisher: Oficiul Registrului Național al Informațiilor Secrete de Stat (ORNISS)
findings.note: The national security authority for classified information independently confirms that the classification regime rests on a statute (Law 182/2002) and a binding Government Decision. The official law portal legislatie.just.ro refused every connection, so no T1 upgrade was possible.

review.reason: The quote places classified-information protection under Law no. 182/2002 and under national standards approved by Government Decision no. 585/2002, so the classification scheme rests on statute and binding regulation.

findings.question: Fingerprint biometric: Fingerprints captured for passports and ID cards where retained centrally
findings.quote: Legea stabilește expres că imaginile amprentelor preluate în bazele de date de producție se șterg, prin procedură automată, imediat după ce titularul a intrat în posesia CEI sau la împlinirea unui termen de 3 luni de la data programată pentru eliberarea actului de identitate.
findings.quote_english: The law expressly provides that fingerprint images captured in the production databases are deleted automatically as soon as the holder receives the CEI, or at the latest 3 months after the scheduled issue date of the identity document.
findings.value: Not retained centrally: CEI fingerprint images are deleted from the production databases after handover, or within 3 months
findings.title: Despre Cartea Electronică de Identitate
findings.note: This answers the gap: Romania keeps no central fingerprint register for ID cards. It does not cover passports.

review.reason: The quote says the law requires fingerprint images in the production databases to be deleted automatically once the holder receives the ID card, or at the latest 3 months after the scheduled issuance date.

findings.question: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today? yes = Operated by the state or a state-controlled body and in operation; partial = Planned or under construction; no = A source states the state operates none
findings.quote: Inginerii și specialiștii care operează centrul de date au pregătire, expertiză și acreditări specifice în astfel de instalații critice și sunt în măsură să asigure disponibilitatea ridicată a centrului de date, securitatea operațională, eficiența energetică și suportul tehnic pentru instituțiile publice din România care au găzduite echipamente în această incintă.
findings.quote_english: The engineers and specialists who operate the data centre have specific training, expertise and accreditations for such critical facilities and can ensure the data centre's high availability, operational security, energy efficiency and technical support for Romanian public institutions that host equipment on these premises.
findings.title: Ministrul Bogdan Ivan anunță finalizarea instalării tuturor echipamentelor pentru cloudul dedicat în centrul de date STS de la Brașov
findings.note: The STS (state) data centre at Cristian, Brașov is in operation, hosts public institutions' equipment and holds TIER III certification; the same release says it houses the government cloud's dedicated component.

review.reason: The quote describes engineers who operate the data centre and give support to the Romanian public institutions whose equipment it already hosts. The page context identifies this as the STS data centre at Cristian, and STS is a state body, so a state-operated data centre is in operation.

findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?
findings.quote: Amplasat în localitatea Cristian, județul Brașov, centrul de date al STS găzduiește deja echipamentele tehnice pentru operaționalizarea componentei de cloud dedicat a cloudului guvernamental al statului român.
findings.quote_english: Located in Cristian, Brașov county, the STS data centre already hosts the technical equipment for putting into operation the dedicated cloud component of the Romanian state's government cloud.
findings.value: Partly: government cloud equipment is installed in the STS data centre, pending operationalisation
findings.title: Ministrul Bogdan Ivan anunță finalizarea instalării tuturor echipamentelor pentru cloudul dedicat în centrul de date STS de la Brașov
findings.note: The ministry release says the hardware for the dedicated government cloud was installed and configuration was the next step, which is consistent with 'Partly'.

review.reason: The quote says the STS data centre already hosts equipment 'for operationalizing' the dedicated government cloud component. That means the equipment is installed but the platform is not stated to be in operation.
